"Rose and Cross" is a short psychological horror in the genre of "walking simulator.

Average time to complete the game: 40 minutes

ATTENTION: Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images, even if they have never been diagnosed with epilepsy.The game contains scenes of violence and murders that can negatively affect the psyche.Some elements may not be suitable for certain age categories.It is recommended to limit the audience of the game reasonably.All coincidences are random and have nothing to do with reality. It is recommended to use headphones to fully immerse yourself in the game.

On the outskirts of a small town stands an abandoned farm surrounded by endless cornfields. The townspeople tell terrible legends that this farm was once inhabited by a sect practicing dark rites, and that these cornfields were sown with blood and fear. The main character is obsessed with studying various sects and occult movements, going, according to rumors, to an abandoned farm, where he will find what he loves so much...

Game Features:

- "Walking Simulator" genre;
- The game is made on the Unreal Engine 5;
- Tense atmosphere;
- Explore an abandoned house;

Midnight Matinee Games2 days ago

Enjoy this no-commentary playthrough! If you like it, be sure to try the game yourself, leave a rating, and support the creator.

Great short game! I loved the atmosphere and sound design, and it looked and ran wonderfully. The pacing was perfect, featuring just the right level of puzzle difficulty to keep things moving briskly toward that brutal ending. 


My only critique is that there were a bit too many jumpscares, to the point where they lost their punch. Some of the most intense moments were the quieter, unresolved setups—like the guy in the bathroom when the lights go out as he crawls toward you, or the figure in the attic appearing with each flick of the light switch without an immediate scare. Leaning more into those tense moments with fewer, well-timed jumpscares would have made the actual scares land much harder. 

Love your games and looking forward to the next one!
